current_decision.message: Sending measurements over Wi-Fi is unsupported because the radios must be disabled in the esp32_bmp280_v1 board family as per the capability context.

clauses.text: Make this pressure node send measurements over Wi-Fi. Bluetooth support is not needed.
clauses.reason: Whole original request retained; no design is authorized. Sending measurements over Wi-Fi is unsupported because the radios must be disabled in the esp32_bmp280_v1 board family as per the capability context.
